propositions: Jira mutation decisions are scattered across multiple layers (differ, apply, ACLI/REST, DC SDK, handlers, orchestration) with multiplied retry ownership and no stable failure scope
No endpoint-failure fuse exists; only per-pass blast-radius guard (classify.check_blast_radius) protects against mass mutation, not against endpoint-family failures
Each logical postcondition must execute within one three-call/15-second budget with deterministic timeout sequence (2s, 4s jitter) and must defer long waits rather than retry early
Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property second, then safety-abort on persistence failure to prevent duplicates

A scoped endpoint-failure fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted outcomes across two tickets per endpoint family or one ticket per provider scope, reset by success, and remain orthogonal to blast-radius protection
Shadow planning must produce immutable per-ticket plans with normalized outcomes, versioned lifecycle intents, and dependency deferral without remote writes, enabling safe cutover by operation family
